sources.title: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it's shifting to a logged-in experience (TechCrunch)
Reddit is the latest platform to embrace the 'For You' feed (TechCrunch)
Reddit stock plunges 29% after weak outlook (CNBC, via search summary)

notes: mc RATES risk-free 4.98% (FRED DGS10, 2026-10-29) and ERP 4.20% (Damodaran implied, 2026-10-01) kept from the prefetch; Damodaran's 1 November update not yet verifiable, so the 1 October value stands.

mc GEOGRAPHY revenue by customer billing address, 9M 2026: US $1,882.6M (79.7%), rest of world $480.7M (20.3%); Q3 2026 US 80.3% / ROW 19.7%; no single non-US country is 10% or more of revenue (10-Q). ROW grew 75% (9M) and 67% (Q3) y/y vs US 57% / 50%. Evidence: pf_10q_20261030.

mc GEOGRAPHY long-lived assets: the 10-K states substantially all long-lived assets are in the United States (no regional amounts disclosed); a regional table is a gap. Evidence: pf_10k_20260206. About 3% of cash and securities is held outside the US (10-Q).

mc EXPOSURE search-engine dependence (Google organic referral and AI Overviews): the 10-Q says declines in referral traffic adversely affected DAUq growth in Q3 2026 and may continue and worsen; US DAUq 50.7M (-2% y/y, -5% q/q per 10-Q), logged-out DAUq 76.8M of 130.3M global (59%), US logged-out 27.3M (-4% y/y). Largest sized bear mechanism; sizing from logged-out share. Evidence: pf_10q_20261030, pf_rel_20261029_1.

mc EXPOSURE management warning (press report of the Q3 call, not read at source): if the search referral trend continues DAUq could fall by a low-double-digit percentage by next quarter; referrals fell by more than 1M per week in October. Attributed to management via mc_tc_20261029 (press lead, transcript to be confirmed by gather_documents).

mc EXPOSURE platform dependence on Google Search, plus Apple/Microsoft/Google browser and OS privacy changes that impair ad measurement (10-Q risk factors); cloud hosted on AWS and Google Cloud Platform (concentration). Not sized by a revenue share: hypothesis. Evidence: pf_10q_20261030.

mc EXPOSURE AI competition: 10-Q names LLMs and AI answer products from Google, Meta, OpenAI and Anthropic as competitors for user attention and as summarizers of Reddit content. Not sized: hypothesis. Evidence: pf_10q_20261030.

mc EXPOSURE regulation: GDPR/UK GDPR, CCPA, FTC Act, EU/UK content-liability regimes; export control and sanctions law (no sanctioned-country revenue stated; China where Reddit is not directly accessible). International is 20% of revenue, no country 10% or more, so tariff exposure is indirect (advertisers) and unsized: hypothesis. Evidence: pf_10q_20261030, pf_10k_20260206.

mc EXPOSURE litigation: securities class action (N.D. Cal., filed June 2025) alleging misstatements on Google Search/AI Overviews impact; complaint dismissed with leave to amend 2026-08-13, second amended complaint filed 2026-10-23, motion to dismiss due on or before 2026-11-23. Damages unspecified. Evidence: pf_10q_20261030.

mc EXPOSURE logged-in transition: from Q4 2026 Reddit will test login requirements in one or more international markets, then intends some form of logged-in restriction globally including the US; the 10-Q warns this could reduce total users and ad reach. Evidence: pf_10q_20261030.

mc NEWS 2026-10-29 Q3 2026 results (8-K Item 2.02): revenue $895.0M (+53% vs $584.9M), global DAUq 130.3M flat q/q (+12% y/y), US ARPU $13.82. Q4 2026 guidance: revenue $1,000-1,030M, Adjusted EBITDA $480-510M (issuer release). Evidence: pf_rel_20261029_1, pf_10q_20261030.

mc NEWS 2026-10-29 company moves toward a mainly logged-in experience as search referrals fall; stated aims: protect data from AI scraping and pursue licensing with model providers; tests begin in select non-US markets in Q4, no global timeline; an 'incognito mode' is being rebuilt (press report). Evidence: mc_tc_20261029.
mc NEWS 2026-10-28 new 'For You' and 'Following' home feed announced (press). Evidence: mc_tc_20261028.

mc NEWS 2026-10-30 market reaction per CNBC search summary: shares fell about 29% after the outlook, worst day on record; JPMorgan cut its price target to $150 from $185 (analyst opinion, attributed; summary of search result, primary article not read). Evidence: mc_cnbc_20261030.
mc NEWS 2026-10-30 law-firm solicitation of investors (Block & Leviton) after the drop: a lead only, no claim evidence.
mc NEWS no other 8-K than the 2026-10-29 earnings release found since the 2026-07-31 10-Q in the prefetch filings list; no export-control, tariff or sanctions action specific to Reddit found.
gaps: long-lived assets by region not disclosed beyond 'substantially all in the United States'
Q3 call transcript not read by this lane; management's DAUq warning rests on press (mc_tc_20261029) and must be confirmed by gather_documents
CNBC and JPMorgan items are search-summary leads; primary articles not opened
Damodaran 1 November 2026 ERP update not checked; 1 October value kept
no BIS/USTR/EU notice searched: no evidenced export-control or tariff exposure for an ad-supported platform with 80% US revenue
stopped: no further press searches: the next retrieval would not change the exposure list; budget kept small
